rows.text: During Cerydra's reign, faith in Talanton flourished like never before. Many people took it upon themselves to crack down on law violations, begging Talanton to pass judgment on all sorts of trivial matters, but the Scale of Justice rarely responded. It was then that the "Eye of Overseer" came into being. It could record sights and sounds to help courts reach verdicts, and could only be used by true believers of Talanton. Before the Flame-Chase Journey began, all Eyes of Overseer were destroyed, as too many people discovered they weren't true believers of Talanton after all.
